name: LongShot AI
tagline: LongShot AI focuses on generating accurate, SEO-friendly long-form blog content with built-in fact-checking powered by web search. It can produce a complete blog post from a keyword, including outline, introduction, and conclusion, with citations. Its FactGPT feature grounds outputs in real-time search results.
